name: init
title_zh: 仓库本地分析，只上传结构化 JSON 的团队上下文起
tagline_zh: 在仓库里翻找散落的背景信息，自动起草团队上下文草稿。敏感细节留在本机，只有整理好的 JSON 出门。
tagline_en: Scans your repo for scattered context, drafts team notes. Sensitive bits stay local; only tidy JSON leaves.
desc_en: Draft team context items from this repository (local analysis; only structured JSON is uploaded).
why_zh: 把「读代码库」和「传数据」切开：分析在本地跑，上传物是干净的结构化 JSON。
why_en: Splits 'reading the repo' from 'sending data': analysis runs locally, uploads are clean JSON—saves tokens and respects privacy.
limit_zh: 只处理当前仓库内的文本与结构；不联网查外部资料，不生成图片或代码。产物是草稿级 JSON，需人工复核后再用于正式上下文。
limit_en: Only handles text/structure in the current repo; no web lookup, no images/code. Output is draft JSON—review before official use.
title_en: Draft team context locally; upload only structured JSON
